raw_specs.value: New 6‑core CPU with 2 performance and 4 efficiency cores
ProMotion technology with adaptive refresh rates up to 120Hz
1,000 nits max brightness (typical); 1,600 nits peak brightness (HDR); 2,000 nits peak brightness (outdoor)
Support for display of multiple languages and characters simultaneously

The iPhone 15 Pro display has rounded corners that follow a beautiful curved design, and these corners are within a standard rectangle. When measured as a standard rectangular shape, the screen is 6.12 inches diagonally (actual viewable area is less).
Rated IP68 (maximum depth of 6 metres up to 30 minutes) under IEC standard 60529⁴
Fast-charge capable: up to 50% charge in around 30 minutes⁷ with 20W adapter or higher (available separately)
Silent mode, Focus, Camera, Torch, Voice Memo, Translate, Magnifier, Shortcut or Accessibility
FaceTime video calling over a mobile network or Wi‑Fi⁹
FaceTime HD (1080p) video calling over 5G or Wi‑Fi⁹
Share experiences like movies, TV, music and other apps in a FaceTime call with SharePlay⁹
Voice Isolation and Wide Spectrum microphone modes⁹
Share experiences like movies, TV, music and other apps in a FaceTime call with SharePlay⁹
Voice Isolation and Wide Spectrum microphone modes⁹
Supported formats include AAC, MP3, Apple Lossless, FLAC, Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital Plus and Dolby Atmos
Next-generation portraits with Focus and Depth Control
4K video recording at 24 fps, 25 fps, 30 fps or 60 fps
1080p HD video recording at 25 fps, 30 fps or 60 fps
Cinematic mode up to 4K HDR at 30 fps
HDR video recording with Dolby Vision up to 4K at 60 fps
ProRes video recording up to 4K at 60 fps with external recording
Slo-mo video support for 1080p at 120 fps
Pro camera system (48MP Main, 12MP Ultra Wide and 12MP Telephoto)
Next-generation portraits with Focus and Depth Control
4K video recording at 24 fps, 25 fps, 30 fps or 60 fps
1080p HD video recording at 25 fps, 30 fps or 60 fps
Cinematic mode for recording videos with shallow depth of field (up to 4K HDR at 30 fps)
Spatial video recording at 1080p at 30 fps
HDR video recording with Dolby Vision up to 4K at 60 fps
ProRes video recording up to 4K at 60 fps with external recording
Macro video recording, including slo‑mo and time‑lapse
Slo-mo video support for 1080p at 120 fps or 240 fps
Second-generation sensor-shift optical image stabilization for video
Enabled by TrueDepth camera for facial recognition
Pay with your iPhone using Face ID in stores, within apps, and on the web
Complete purchases made with Apple Pay on your Mac
Pay for your journey using Express Transit¹¹
Precision dual-frequency GPS (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, BeiDou and NavIC)

Supported formats include HEVC, H.264, AV1 and ProRes HDR with Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG Up to 4K HDR AirPlay for mirroring, photos and video out to Apple TV (2nd generation or later) or AirPlay-enabled smart TV Video mirroring and video out support: up to 4K HDR through native DisplayPort output over USB-C or USB-C Digital AV Adapter (model A2119; adapter sold separately)¹⁴
Use your voice to send messages, set reminders and more¹⁵
Activate hands‑free with only your voice using “Siri” or “Hey Siri”¹⁵
Use your voice to run shortcuts from your favourite apps¹⁵
